question: What divine states and lordships characterize the deity absorbed in yogic sleep?
premises: The deity delights in yogic sleep.
He is lord of Śrī and lord of the gods.
He is the dwelling place of all.
inference: The deity in yogic sleep is the universal abode and sovereign lord of Śrī and the gods.
plain_english: He saw the lord of Śrī, delighting in yogic sleep, the dwelling of all, the lord of the gods.
